LOBIA.Status.heading: Statuses
LOBIA.Status.brulure.name: Burn
LOBIA.Status.brulure.rule: −5 Physical. At the end of the turn, take XD4 recoil damage.
LOBIA.Status.confusion.name: Confusion
LOBIA.Status.confusion.rule: When acting, roll 1D4. On a 1, the action is cancelled and take XD8 recoil damage.
LOBIA.Status.empoisonnement.name: Poison
LOBIA.Status.empoisonnement.rule: At the end of the turn, take XD6 recoil damage.
LOBIA.Status.grave-empoisonnement.name: Severe poison
LOBIA.Status.grave-empoisonnement.rule: After using an action, bonus action, or reaction, take 1D4 recoil damage.
LOBIA.Status.gel.name: Freeze
LOBIA.Status.gel.rule: −5 Special. At the end of the turn, take XD4 recoil damage.
LOBIA.Status.somnolence.name: Drowsiness
LOBIA.Status.somnolence.rule: −5 Armor and −5 Barrier. When acting, roll 1D6; on a 1, the action is cancelled.
LOBIA.Status.peur.name: Fear
LOBIA.Status.peur.rule: Lose all Reactions until the end of the next turn.
LOBIA.Status.paralysie.name: Paralysis
LOBIA.Status.paralysie.rule: When acting, roll 1D4; on a 1, the action is cancelled. Movement is halved and sprinting is impossible.
LOBIA.Status.aveuglement.name: Blindness
LOBIA.Status.aveuglement.rule: When targeting an opponent, roll 1D6; on an odd result, the action fails.
LOBIA.Status.amour.name: Infatuation
LOBIA.Status.amour.rule: When targeting the beloved, roll 1D4; on a 1, the action fails. If the beloved is in melee and targeted by an attack, roll 1D6; on an odd result, protect the target. Ends if the beloved leaves combat or is K.O.
LOBIA.Status.provocation.name: Taunt
LOBIA.Status.provocation.rule: May target only the character who caused the taunt, and cannot use non-offensive moves.
LOBIA.Status.entrave.name: Disable
LOBIA.Status.entrave.rule: Lose all Actions until the end of the next turn. Cannot be applied to someone who had this status on the previous turn.
LOBIA.Status.parasite.name: Leech
LOBIA.Status.parasite.rule: At the end of the turn, take XD4 recoil damage. The user recovers HP equal to the damage dealt.
LOBIA.Status.debris-de-pierre.name: Stone debris
LOBIA.Status.debris-de-pierre.rule: Whenever attempting to dodge, successful or not, take XD6 recoil damage.
LOBIA.Status.maudit.name: Cursed
LOBIA.Status.maudit.rule: Whenever an Action, bonus action, or Reaction is used, take XD6 recoil damage.
LOBIA.Status.ko.name: K.O
LOBIA.Status.ko.rule: Cannot act even after being healed until combat ends, or at the GM's discretion. At 0 HP, a character is K.O and may still take damage. At −10 HP, the journey ends.
